nvitk.db.local_dicom_assets
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.local_dicom_assets

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Register local DICOM files under per-subject modality folders into ``assets``.

   Expected layout::

       {dicom_root}/{subject_uid}/4Dflow_AP/**/*.dcm
       {dicom_root}/{subject_uid}/4Dflow_FH/**/*.dcm
       {dicom_root}/{subject_uid}/4Dflow_RL/**/*.dcm
       {dicom_root}/{subject_uid}/TOF/**/*.dcm

   Each DICOM file becomes one ``assets`` row. ``asset_slot`` is a short, stable key per
   sequence folder (e.g. ``tof``, ``4dflow_ap``), aligned with :mod:`nvitk.db.local_nifti_assets`
   and XNAT sync. Wide tables use ``subject_uid`` + ``asset_slot`` (one column per sequence).

   Files are included if they look like DICOM (``*.dcm``, ``*.dicom``, ``*.ima``, ``*.img``,
   case-insensitive) or have no extension (common for raw exports); obvious junk names are skipped.

   Do not store secrets in the dataset; this module only records file paths.

   See also :mod:`nvitk.db.local_nifti_assets` for the NIfTI variant.

   :value: None

.. py:data:: _JUNK_NAMES

.. py:function:: _is_probably_dicom_file(path: pathlib.Path) -> bool

   Heuristic DICOM detection by name: excludes hidden/junk files, accepts known DICOM extensions
   and extensionless files (common for raw exports).


.. py:function:: _iter_dicoms_under(folder: pathlib.Path) -> Iterable[pathlib.Path]

   Yield every file under *folder* that looks like a DICOM slice, sorted; nothing if *folder*
   isn't a directory.


.. py:function:: register_dicom_tree(dicom_root: str | pathlib.Path, *, source: str = 'local_dicom', pipeline_id: str | None = None, pipeline_name: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Build ``assets`` rows for DICOM trees under ``dicom_root`` (one row per file).


.. py:function:: upsert_dicom_assets(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, dicom_root: str | pathlib.Path, *, source: str = 'local_dicom', pipeline_id: str | None = None, pipeline_name: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False, build_sqlite_index: bool = False) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Compute DICOM asset rows and upsert into ``repo`` unless ``dry_run``.


.. py:function:: _cli_decorator(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)

   No-op stand-in for ``click.command``/``click.option`` when ``click`` isn't installed.

.. py:data:: _click_option

.. py:function:: main(dataset_root: pathlib.Path, dicom_root: pathlib.Path, source: str, pipeline_id: str | None, pipeline_name: str | None, source_batch_id: str | None, dry_run: bool, build_sqlite_index: bool) -> None

   CLI entry point: scaffold/open the dataset at ``dataset_root`` and register the DICOM tree at
